description: Source code for a Zephyr-based network statistics sampling application, including functions for collecting and printing network interface statistics, handling IPv4/IPv6/UDP/TCP protocols, and periodic timer setup.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints network statistics for a given interface or global data.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback for iterating over network interfaces to print their stats.

methods.name: eth_iface_cb
methods.description: Callback for Ethernet interfaces to print Ethernet stats.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Periodic function to gather and print all network statistics.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes the periodic statistics collection timer.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the app.
